basic_info.description: Welcome to 550 South Van Ness Ave #104! This charming garden-level, corner unit residence features 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, 1-car side-by-side parking, spanning approximately 734 square feet with beautiful wood flooring throughout. It's one of the few units in the building offering direct access to the shared patio space. The open-concept design effortlessly blends the kitchen, dining and living areas, ideal for entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with stunning granite countertops, sleek stainless steel appliances, new microwave and ample cabinet space. The bathroom, located just off the main hallway, showcases new hexagonal floor tiles and updated lighting. This boutique building, with only 36 units, offers a secure lobby, garage and multiple shared patio areas. Enjoy unparalleled convenience with easy access to the 101 freeway, Valencia corridor, BART and tech bus stops. Located in the vibrant Inner Mission District, you'll be surrounded by an array of dining options, a lively nightlife scene and close proximity to San Francisco's iconic Mission Dolores Park. 100 Walk Score, 100 Bike Score, 94 Transit Score. More information at 550southvanness104.com
